$comment: INTERACTIVE layer config (Claude Code hooks + shell gates). Read by .claude/hooks/{pre-write-check,pre-commit-gate,post-write-lint,stop-gate,stop-review}.sh, scripts/{gate,review}.sh, scripts/ratchet.mjs and eslint/boundaries.config.mjs. Sibling configs: agent-harness.json = headless pipeline (agent-harness CLI); agent-toolkit.json = lint + write-guard policy and the single source for protectedDirs. Do not delete this file — four active hooks fail closed without it.
$reconciled: Adapted for the operator-ui pnpm workspace (biome + vitest, apps/*/src layout). Biome remains the linter/formatter; boundaries/compiler/fallow are enforced by operator-ui's own eslint.config.mjs + harness-gate.sh, so those checks here are advisory ('report') to avoid double-blocking. The harness eslint fragment (eslint/base.config.mjs) is installed as reference only (its id-denylist bans `data` and caps useState, which the react-query code would trip). relatedTests is 'off' — vitest is per-package (pnpm -r test), not resolvable from the workspace root. duplication is 'report' — fallow audit scopes against origin/master and would block on inherited in-flight-branch dead-code; operator-ui's fallow stage owns that gate. Only protectedDirs and gitleaks block. Post-install fix applied to .claude/hooks/*.sh: HOOK_DIR/../scripts -> ../../scripts (install.sh puts hooks under .claude/hooks but scripts at project root).
e2eCommand: npx --no-install playwright test && E2E_APP=fman npx --no-install playwright test

boundaries.$comment: Disabled: operator-ui enforces feature boundaries via its own eslint.config.mjs (lint:boundaries) + check-structure.mjs. This block only feeds the unused eslint/boundaries.config.mjs reference fragment.
